gpu_identity_scope: Same explicitly declared unmasked ordinal; full native/tensor device proof delegated to parent verifier
limitations: One fixed actor/seed/episode perdt; no statistical robustness, root-cause identification or stability certification.
Both physical integration and explicitDC-PD update frequency change200→400Hz. This is not a contact-solver-only intervention or a newly trained policy.
Native>10Hz spectra have different Nyquist limits100/200Hz; compare the separately reported common10<f<100Hz band, not unequal-bandwidth totals.
Adjacent native force/torque differences cover different dt and bandwidth; smaller step differences alone do not establish improvement.
Count>0 and upwardFz>5N eligibility are diagnostics. Missing thresholded points is not proof of geometric flight or an XY failure gate.
Raw native1397/2793 states retain their own times; no alignment/resampling/pose correction. Both contain349original50Hz decisions.
Tracking alone interpolates the locked reference at original native query times; raw physical states are not interpolated or resampled.
Physical6.98s exceeds locked reference6.96s; full tracking remains unavailable without extrapolation; reference-overlap tracking is separately labeled.

camera.lookat: Same locked reference root position+[0,0,-.24] for both panels; hold last knot after6.96s

rendering_limitations: Video50Hz selects existing native200Hz/400Hz states at strides4/8; no interpolation or timestamp warping.
Movie frames cannot establish uninterrupted contact or resolve all native substep chatter.
Counts are measured ground points. Zero count is not proof of flight; eligibility=count>0 AND upward Fz>5N is diagnostic only.
Same fixed original8ba actor, policy50Hz, reward and PD500/10; this is a zero-shot numerical/contact-update diagnostic, not retraining.
Original world poses, height and timing are retained; robots are not individually recentered if they leave the shared reference-follow camera.
Replay uses FK/graphics only. It is not a new simulation, contact solver or safety certification.

notes: Official MJCF/STL assets are preserved; generated robot.xml changes only meshdir, names the floating root joint, and adds IK/display sites.
left/right_wheel sites are wheel hinge centers, not human ankle frames; left/right_knee sites are actual knee joint centers.
left/right_contact are nominal local bottom markers: they rotate with the wheel and are NOT rolling contact points or reliable ground clearance. Compute clearance from collision geometry instead.

Official MJCF and Isaac USD share link offsets and joint axes, but are not numerically identical dynamics models. MJCF base includes fixed IMU mass; wheel collision axial width is 0.010m versus 0.050m in USD, and lateral collision offsets are +/-0.008m versus +/-0.00707m.
Official MJCF wheel motor ctrlrange is +/-40Nm, while the imported USD drive maxForce is 80. Other collision primitives also differ; no cross-engine contact or actuator equivalence is implied.
Mink IK playback does not validate contact forces, balance, jump actuation, self-collision avoidance, or dynamic feasibility. No Isaac assets or runtime are changed.

validation.note: Geometric/FK checks only. Contacts include margin contacts and do not prove dynamically feasible balance or jumping.
